title: Use integrated unfinished-site hazards for a conditional clean-completion bound
statement: For independent intended clocks T_i~Exp(a_i),a_i>0, damage h_i active until T_i and ordered wrong-pair hazard w_ij active only until min(T_i,T_j), clean completion equals E exp(-sum h_i*T_i-sum w_ij*min(T_i,T_j)). Jensen gives a lower bound exp(-sum h_i/a_i-sum w_ij/(a_i+a_j)); finite deadlines require the separately conditioned clock formula.

requires: Independent exponential intended clocks, nonnegative independent Poisson damage/wrong clocks, a_i>0 and precisely specified active intervals.
Wrong-pair rates are ordered; finite-deadline formula uses t>0 and conditional independent truncated clocks.
provides: For independent intended clocks T_i~Exp(a_i),a_i>0, damage h_i active until T_i and ordered wrong-pair hazard w_ij active only until min(T_i,T_j), clean completion equals E exp(-sum h_i*T_i-sum w_ij*min(T_i,T_j)). Jensen gives a lower bound exp(-sum h_i/a_i-sum w_ij/(a_i+a_j)); finite deadlines require the separately conditioned clock formula.

body: Condition on all intended times and multiply independent Poisson survival probabilities. For a deadline t>0 multiply by the event max T_i<=t. Let p_i=1-exp(-a_i*t), m_i=1/a_i-t/(exp(a_i*t)-1), and m_ij=integral_0^t [(exp(-a_i*u)-exp(-a_i*t))/p_i]*[(exp(-a_j*u)-exp(-a_j*t))/p_j]du. Conditional Jensen yields product p_i times exp(-sum h_i*m_i-sum w_ij*m_ij). Ordered pair rates must not be silently counted as unordered rates. Hazards from finished sites, persistent product footprints as in N1024, nonindependent clocks and changed reaction geometry are outside these hypotheses. The source999-site0.987429236 and MC/DP comparisons are hypothetical reported diagnostics, not measured yield or a replay of the missing earlier program.
